items.scene: Lina saw the note under the mat. Noah later moved it to the mailbox, but Lina did not see the move.
items.question: What does Lina think Noah believes about the note?
options: Noah thinks the note is still under the mat.
Noah thinks the note is in the mailbox.
Noah knows Lina saw the note.
Lina thinks the note is in the mailbox.
items.why_this_case_matters: Direct second-order belief: outer thinker Lina, inner thinker Noah.

items.scene: Lina saw the note under the mat. Noah later moved it to the mailbox, but Lina did not see the move.
items.question: What does Noah believe about the note?
options: It is still under the mat.
Lina believes it is in the mailbox.
Lina believes it is still under the mat.
items.why_this_case_matters: Near-miss first-order belief; no nested belief is asked for.

items.scene: Lina saw the note under the mat. Noah later moved it to the mailbox, but Lina did not see the move.
items.question: Where is the note really?
options: Lina thinks it is in the mailbox
Noah thinks it is under the mat
items.why_this_case_matters: Boundary case about reality only; not a recursive belief task.

items.scene: Pia saw the ring on the shelf. After Pia left, Drew put it in the box. Pia did not see the move.
items.question: What does Drew think Pia believes about the ring?
options: Pia believes it is still on the shelf.
Pia believes it is in the box.
Drew believes Pia saw the move.
Pia knows it is in the box.
items.why_this_case_matters: Tests the common shortcut of answering from reality instead of Drew's model of Pia's belief.
